summary.text: Keri Heintzeman is a Republican state senator who represents District 6 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Denise Slipy.
Her career experience includes work in logging and construction.

paragraphs.text: Heintzeman assumed office in the Minnesota State Senate on May 6, 2025, succeeding Justin Eichorn, and her current term ends in January 2027.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working in logging and construction.
